parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's Marquis2019 parameter set, for a graphite/LCO cell, compiled from several sources for Marquis et al. 2019. Exported to BPX by battinfo-records (scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py).

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/2.0341915jes as implemented in PyBaMM's Marquis2019 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
PyBaMM names a Kokam SLPB78205130H, but the values are compiled from several sources, so no cell is linked.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 0.23 mV RMS and 0.003% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C and 1C 20 K warmer).
The separator porosity is 1 in PyBaMM. It is written as 1 - 1e-9 because PyBaMM's BPX importer divides by its logarithm.
